reviews.name: We Left It Behind
reviews.text: We adopted our Frenchie previously known as Lil’ Stevie at 4 months old. We named him Nash ♥️ as we flew to Nashville NC to get him. He is extremely well tempered, very much a cuddle bug and loves kids. He has zero medical issues!!! Nash loves all food and is the first well adjusted fur baby we have added to our family. We cannot believe he is SIX already!!! What the actual heck…he is super good with all dogs and kitties. Nash is built like a brick house and he doesn’t have to work for any of those muscles 😂 trust!!! He adapts to whatever we are doing and wants to be involved in everything. We love him so much and cannot imagine life without him. Rene was amazing right from the beginning while we were texting and messaging all the way up to when we went cross country to get him. Nash has traveled the country with us and currently calls Southern Utah home. Rene has always been available to us via message and we have never lost contact.  I know I can reach out anytime if I needed to. If you are thinking about a Frenchie in today’s world where so many are trying to just make some quick cash and do not care about the health of these poor babies… we recommend Ethical Frenchie’s. They can be trusted  for sure!!! Thank you for our beautiful baby boy.

reviews.name: Hello Miss Mabel
reviews.text: I highly recommend Ethical Frenchie! My puppy’s medical record was completely documented and provided to me. I know French bulldogs, and I knew at first glance this was my puppy was impeccably bred. Her proportions, her jet black coat, that face! I would definitely buy again from Ethical Frenchie. In the past I made the mistake of using an online broker through PuppySp*t.com. Please use common sense and only work with an actual breeder who you can talk to and who communicates with you about everything. Trust is a big part of getting a puppy, even more so, (much much more so), when it comes to a French bulldog. I trust Ethical Frenchie 100% and feel so blessed to have a healthy baby girl named Mabel!

reviews.name: Diego David
reviews.text: I got both of my French Bulldogs from Ethical Frenchies— (one is now 6 years old) and (the other is now 3 months old)—and they’ve both been absolutely amazing. Healthy, happy, and such a joy to have. Renee and James make the process so simple, provide tons of helpful resources, and truly care about their pups. Couldn’t recommend them more!

reviews.name: Rhiannon Lupo
reviews.text: Ethical Frenchie is truly the best! Working with them has been such a pleasure. I worked specifically with Renee and she was beyond helpful. She provided me with plenty of information as a first time dog owner and helpful tips to keep my frenchie as healthy as possible. Renee hand delievered our frenchie boy which was so convenient and helpful. Even after 2 years she regularly checks in to see how our boy is doing. We had such an amazing experience that my mom ended up purchasing a frenchie girl. Now our two frenchies are best buds and we couldn’t be happier with our fluffy family members!

reviews.name: nikol beljakovic
reviews.text: Had the best possible experience working with this company; as it was my first dog they guided me and educated me every step of the way from types of food, general pet care, and behaviors and development! My Benny has been super healthy since day 1 and has a sweet and playful temperament with other dogs and my young family members. I still keep in touch with the breeders on how he is doing to this day! Couldn't recommend them more.

reviews.name: Erica Skurnik Podnos
reviews.text: We had the best experience getting our dog from Ethical Frenchie! They are extremely well informed about the breed and helped answer all our questions along the way, and for months after we got him. Our puppy is also THE cutest frenchie in the world (not biased at all) so would add 6 stars if I could 😊

reviews.name: David Kirsch
reviews.text:
Getting my Frenchie from Ethical Frenchie was the BEST decision! From the start, Renee was amazing.  She answered all my questions (and I had a lot!) through emails, phone calls, and even FaceTime. I was a total newbie to Frenchies, but Renee was so patient and helpful, guiding me through everything.

I got my little guy when he was just 8 weeks old and now he is almost a year and a half, and he's super healthy! Ethical Frenchie clearly cares about their pups from day one.  I've always fed him fresh food (Ollie's, Farmer's Dog, Spot & Tango) and avoided kibble. I believe that's made a big difference in his health.  You pay for quality food now, or pay later in vet bills!

I can't recommend Ethical Frenchie (and Renee!) enough. If you're looking for a Frenchie breeder who truly cares, this is the place!

reviews.name: Eva H
reviews.text: They provide the best class of services and premium French Bulldog. I’m so happy of getting Nugget from them. And Renee is the best, she is always patient to answer your questions.

reviews.name: Alexa Petratos
reviews.text: I cannot recommend Ethical Frenchie enough! Renee has been absolutely amazing since the beginning. Fast forward 3 months, and I still cannot thank her enough for her constant responsiveness, help and support. We were the most skeptic clients - from my husband not being a dog person, to fearing the many health concerns and maintenance that this breed can often require. I had done a ton of research and spoke to Renee several times throughout the initial process. She was always available to answer any question with honesty and factual information. She never pressured us and she made it clear how much she cares to match her babies with the right family. She was kind enough to allow us into her home to meet the litter of puppies. Since finding our LeBron 🐾🩵, I have received the most attentive help from Renee each and every time we had any questions or health related scares (mainly related me being a psycho new dog mom). She has provided so many holistic suggestions when it comes to caring for our fur baby. The type of knowledge that Renee possesses can only come from years of experience, true passion and love for animals. We get stopped on the street every five minutes in regard to how healthy, well behaved and adorable our little guy is. The vet said that he’s the quietest breathing frenchie that he’s ever seen! I truly am so grateful that we found such a loving and responsible breeder and I hope to have a frenchie clan from EF in the future!

reviews.name: Santino Lopez
reviews.text: Renee was so helpful throughout the entire process. She made sure to reach out during Bacon’s first few weeks at home to help answer any questions, and she even provided a detailed list of things to help Bacon stay healthy! Here are a few pictures of Bacon, he’s one happy dog!

reviews.name: Cassandra Valentin
reviews.text: I don’t usually write reviews (and this one is way overdue), but as we are contemplating getting our second Frenchie w/ TEF, I was reminded how important it is to let people know how amazing they are. Our 2 yr old pup Frida is pretty much as perfect as can be. She is calm, polite, playful, and loving, not to mention absolutely adorable! Everyone who meets her loves her and we often get stopped by people wanting to pet, compliment, and even take pictures of her. I recommend TEF to anyone thinking about getting a Frenchie (which, btw, I also highly recommend!) It’s clear that they take great care in breeding and preparing these pups to be the best, most loving friends you could ever want :)

reviews.name: Mint Kongphat
reviews.text:

reviews.name: Michael Hutchins
reviews.text: We are in love with our new addition to our family. Renee has been wonderful through our initial meeting , our purchase and delivery. 8 months later she always answers any questions we might have and is a wealth of information. Thank you so much

reviews.name: John Vejarano
reviews.text:
I couldn't be happier finding ethical frenchie one day looking through Google because I didn't want to go through conventional pet store. Unlike those places, when I reached out to inquire about the puppies, Renee got back to me pretty quickly. She was very helpful every step of the process. She  provided medical history for my pup and a list of product recommendations. When the day came to finally meet our new baby she came to our apartment and even gave us the the pet carrier he arrived in. She made sure he was okay the first few nights after he transitioned and we have maintained in contact incase of anything.

Spike is such a bundle of joy. The most sweetest, toughest frenchie you'll ever meet with beautiful ocean eyes. He's changed our lives in so many ways and I'm glad that we found a reputable and caring breeder like Renne. I will always recommend her and if we decide to give spike a brother or sister we would choose ethical frenchies again.

reviews.name: Nicole Pearson
reviews.text: I purchased a beautiful French Bulldog from ethical Frenchie and I could not be happier with my fur baby! I did so much research on breeders locally and across the country. I am located in Pennsylvania and I am lucky that they are not too far from me. I have two other frenchies that came from Indiana. From the moment I connected with them I could tell how much they care and put into making sure the home these pups are going to is a safe and loving place! My girl is happy and healthy! I of course checked and rechecked previous reviews and I always look at the “lowest” reviews first. There is no way the couple reviews could be legit! I’m not going to lie reading them made me skeptical, however, I went with my gut, and I am so happy I did. Purchasing a French bulldog is a huge commitment and obviously not cheap, but I could not be happier. I was provided with all of her medical records as well as provided with the name of the vet she had been seeing since birth. I brought her to my vet, who specializes in brachycephalic dogs and he said she is very healthy and he saw not a single issue. Tested her stool and not parasites or worms. If you are like me and love frenchies, but of course want a healthy baby to bring home to your family I am telling you from experience you can trust going with ethical frenchies for your new addiction to your family!

reviews.name: Elanadogi Bismakizaho
reviews.text: Highly Recommended

reviews.name: Dillon Goad
reviews.text:
This review is long overdue. Renee is absolutely amazing!! Her practice is as ethical and amazing as it's billed to be. She's the honest, caring, small family operation breeder you've been scouring the internet to find. We made the decision to adopt one of her amazing puppies last April, and our sweet baby Gus just turned 1 year old last month. He's perfectly healthy and happy and we are so grateful to Renee.

I feel the need to provide our in depth experience here for any others like us in the future who are embarking on the daunting task of trying to find an honest/ethical French Bulldog breeder. My wife and I had made the mistake in the past of going through a more affordable French Bulldog breeder option we found through Instagram back in 2018. We unfortunately were sold a terminally ill puppy with an inoperable hereditary heart condition he inherited through poor breeding. We gave him the best life we could for as long as we could but unfortunately suffered through the heartbreak of his passing around his 1 year birthday. We were obviously scarred from this experience and vowed that if we ever decided to get another Frenchie we would never make the mistake of choosing the wrong breeder again.

Fast forward to early 2022, we began the daunting search you're likely on now, armed with a ton of knowledge about what scams to avoid and what questions to ask to properly vet our potential breeders. We started our search with Ethical Frenchies through a referral of someone we met walking a beautiful, happy Frenchie puppy in the city. This owner raved about her experience with Ethical Frenchies. We called Renee, told her about our prior experience, and then proceeded to ask her a laundry list of questions about her process. She was ready for all of them and answered them so genuinely. Not only was she not running a puppy-mill, she was just as concerned on doing her due diligence on us as owners to ensure the future welfare of any puppy she sold. We absolutely loved this!

We told her we were pretty certain we wanted a male and weren't too picky on color but had a preference for blues if we had the option. We also mentioned we preferred the thicker body type (she called it a "chunker"). We expected to be put on a waitlist with all the post-COVID puppy demand, but, as fate would have it, she said that she actually had a litter with a "chunker" blue male that would be ready for pickup in only 4 weeks!

Still scarred from our prior experience, we weren't done vetting yet. We proceeded to read everyone of these Google reviews and reach out to about a dozen of her recent clients via IG. Nearly every single one of them responded immediately with the highest praise for Renee. One of them had actually gone back and bought a second puppy from her! This was the final confirmation we needed. We paid our deposit and were thrilled by the very detailed contract complete with conditional vet signoff from our own vet. Renee provided us all the information on the parents of this puppy with pictures and health records.

In walked our Augustus ("Gus") on 4/6/2022. We immediately took him to two different vets that not only gave him a clean bill of health, but both told us he was one of the healthiest French Bulldog puppies they had seen with several noticeable traits of great breeding (wide nostrils, normal pallet, non-inverted tail, etc.).

True to the other reviews, Renee has stayed in constant communication with us ever since dropping him off. It started with her amazing welcome PDF of all the essential supplies we'd need and links of where to buy them off Amazon. She answered all of our random questions throughout the early months. She even connected us to another young couple that bought Gus's sister and also lives in the city. We've met up regularly and are going to do a joint 1 year birthday celebration for them next week (I know, we're those millennials).

Gus is as happy and healthy as ever. He's a hilarious little drama king. He is so sweet and good with other people & other dogs. He is our world. Thank you, Renee!
